# harvester_kubeovn_iptables_eip (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "harvester_kubeovn_iptables_eip" "example" {
  name = "my-eip"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A unique name

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Any text you want that better describes this resource
- `external_subnet` (String) Name of the external subnet the address is taken from, one of the external_subnets of the NAT gateway. kube-ovn uses the subnet ovn-vpc-external-network when it is omitted, which Harvester does not create.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `mac_address` (String) MAC address of the EIP. kube-ovn generates one when it is omitted.
- `message` (String)
- `nat_gw_dp` (String) Name of the VPC NAT gateway the EIP is attached to.
- `qos_policy` (String) Name of the kube-ovn QoS policy applied to the EIP.
- `state` (String)
- `status_ip` (String) Address of the EIP applied by kube-ovn.
- `status_nat` (String) Comma-separated kinds of NAT rules using the EIP (snat, dnat, fip).
- `status_qos_policy` (String) QoS policy applied by kube-ovn.
- `tags` (Map of String)
- `v4_ip` (String) IPv4 address of the EIP, inside the CIDR of external_subnet. kube-ovn allocates a free one when it is omitted.
- `v6_ip` (String) IPv6 address of the EIP, in lower case and inside the CIDR of external_subnet.
